articles.title: 3 Highlights from Thomas Kurian's Keynote at the Goldman Sachs Communicopia & Technology Conference
articles.summary: Thomas Kurian participated in the Goldman Sachs Tech Conference, providing an update on Google Cloud's business and strategy.
articles.detail: Google Cloud is the only provider to offer solutions across the entire AI stack, which expands its total addressable market, differentiates its products from the point of view of performance, cost and quality.

articles.title: Build AI-powered file classification with AWS Transfer Family
articles.summary: Organizations that receive files from external partners through SFTP face a persistent operational challenge: routing each file to the correct downstream system.
articles.detail: The traditional approach - pattern-matching on file names with regular expressions - is inherently fragile. It relies on manual curation of complex rules, which can lead to errors and inconsistencies.

articles.title: Enable zero-copy access to AWS services on Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP with Amazon S3 Access Points
articles.summary: Semiconductor verification teams run thousands of simulation jobs every night using Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools.
articles.detail: A large verification environment can generate logs from 100,000 or more test executions per night. A single regression cycle produces simulation logs, compilation logs, and scheduler logs.

articles.title: Retirement: Azure Linux with OS Guard in Azure Kubernetes Service
articles.summary: Support for Azure Linux with OS Guard in Azure Kubernetes Service will end on December 10, 2026.
articles.detail: Azure Container Linux is the replacement for Azure Linux with OS Guard (preview). Starting on December 10, 2026: Users won't be able to create new Azure Linux instances.

articles.title: [In preview] Public Preview: Agentless migration of on-premises SMB file shares to Azure Files (SMB)
articles.summary: Azure Storage Mover now supports agentless migration of on-premises SMB file shares to Azure Files (SMB), in public preview.
articles.detail: You can move file data from Windows Server or NAS shares into Azure without deploying, registering, or maintaining a migration agent.

articles.title: Skild AI Taps NVIDIA Physical AI to Teach Robots New Tasks From a Single Video
articles.summary: Manufacturing floors, warehouses and production lines rarely stay fixed - tasks change, layouts shift and new products arrive, and most robots can't keep up without significant reprogramming.
articles.detail: Skild AI's new S1 robot foundation model helps address this, designed to learn previously unseen, long-horizon tasks from a single video demonstration.

articles.title: Physical AI Takes the Wheel: How the World's Robotaxi Leaders Are Building With NVIDIA Technologies
articles.summary: The global robotaxi market - physical AI's first commercial breakthrough - is projected to reach $400 billion by 2035, with over 6 million commercial vehicles in operation as driverless fleets are already moving people through some of the world's busiest and most complex streets.
articles.detail: Deploying a driverless vehicle is one challenge. Scaling a fleet is another. Building an entire ecosystem to support autonomous transportation requires an even broader set of technologies and partnerships.

articles.title: NVIDIA and Palantir Bring Sovereign Intelligence to Critical Supply Chains
articles.summary: Palantir Technologies Inc. (NASDAQ: PLTR) and NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) today announced a collaboration to bring sovereign AI to critical supply chains, starting with NVIDIA's own operations.

articles.title: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Copilot Troubleshooting Agent
articles.summary: Azure Copilot Troubleshooting Agent is now generally available.
articles.detail: Troubleshooting Agent is a unified, built-in Azure Copilot capability that helps customers investigate and resolve operational issues faster.

articles.title: Oracle shares rally: Can strong AI demand sustain Oracle's stock surge?
articles.summary: Oracle shares jumped in after-hours trading after the software giant reported stronger-than-expected fiscal first-quarter results, with booming AI demand driving rapid growth in its cloud infrastructure business.
